summary: Implemented the engine-free savers and plot function per the spec, but nothing was executed (tests, flake8, and ignite attach were not run, as instructed). Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; the three handlers (segmentation_saver, classification_saver, tensorboard_handlers) reduced to thin adapters; nifti_writer default dtype changed to np.float32; output_path renamed to output_dir in two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py; new tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py passes filename; docs/source/data.rst lists the new modules. Choices: plot selects data[index] before branching, so (1,1,10,10) yields the _HW_0 suffix; the classification completion hook is a private engine-accepting wrapper; the CSV reader skips blank rows. No commits were made. Test files were written by reading only and have not been executed.
